home.hero_title: Smart Foliar Disease Diagnosis & Crop Advisory
home.hero_subtitle: High-precision deep learning diagnosis for 10 major agricultural crops with strict out-of-distribution rejection and soil-climate crop recommendation.
home.feature_1_desc: Specialized MobileNetV2 architecture fine-tuned for Apple, Bell Pepper, Corn, Cotton, Grape, Green Gram, Pigeon Pea, Potato, Soybean, and Tomato.
home.feature_2_desc: Two-stage foliar integrity and 128-d cosine centroid similarity gating prevents misclassification of unsupported crops or non-leaf photos.
home.feature_3_desc: Random Forest intelligence recommending the optimal crop out of 22 supported species based on N-P-K, pH, temperature, and rainfall.

result.pathology_note_text: This diagnosis is based on Xanthomonas bacterial necrotic lesions with yellow halos. If your uploaded leaf was from soybean (such as bacterial blight/pustule), the model matched the identical bacterial lesion morphology, as the benchmark dataset catalogs healthy soybean foliage.
result.about_condition_sub: Pathogen overview and nature of infestation
result.identified_symptoms_sub: Key visual characteristics on foliage, stems, and fruit
result.prevention_practices_sub: Agronomic methods to prevent outbreak recurrence
result.disclaimer_text: This system provides preliminary AI-based diagnostics for educational and decision-support purposes. Always verify with local university extension personnel or certified agricultural officers, and strictly follow registered chemical manufacturer safety labels and pre-harvest intervals before applying pesticides.

ood.unsupported_crop_msg: This image does not appear to belong to a crop supported by the current model.
ood.unsupported_crop_desc: The AI system performs rigorous crop validation prior to disease diagnosis to prevent false diagnoses. Uncataloged crops or unsupported conditions are safely rejected instead of being forced into an unrelated disease class.
ood.invalid_image_title: Unable to confidently identify this image.
ood.invalid_image_sub: Please upload a clear leaf image belonging to one of the supported crops.
ood.invalid_image_badge: Prediction unavailable — invalid or non-leaf image
ood.invalid_image_desc: The uploaded image does not meet foliar quality standards or appears to contain fruits, objects, or non-leaf structures. The deep learning model is specialized strictly for single crop leaves.
ood.ambiguous_soybean_msg: Soybean detected, but disease could not be reliably identified.
ood.tip_single_leaf: Single Leaf: Photograph a single leaf close-up. Avoid fruits, bark, roots, or whole plant fields.
ood.tip_focus: Focus & Lighting: Ensure spots, blights, or lesions are sharply in focus under natural daylight.
ood.tip_background: Neutral Background: Avoid capturing complex soil backgrounds, hands, weeds, or indoor objects.
ood.tip_crops: Supported Crops: Apple, Bell Pepper, Corn, Cotton, Grape, Green Gram, Pigeon Pea, Potato, Soybean, and Tomato.
ood.supported_policy_desc: Full disease diagnosis is supported for 10 crops: Apple, Bell Pepper, Corn, Cotton, Grape, Green Gram, Pigeon Pea, Potato, Soybean, and Tomato across 31 pathologies. Non-crop images, weeds, fruits, or uncataloged crops are safely rejected.
